title: Page start-up states (boot)
caption: What `boot()` of `src/boot.js` shows while and after `storefront.get` answers. Texts from `lib/i18n.js` (`state.*`); templates in `partials/states.html`. Pages render the same inline states for their own calls with `renderState`.

states.label: Loading
states.detail: Static page painted; the live region says "Loading" if the configuration takes a moment.

states.label: Ready
states.detail: Theme, header, footer, test banner applied; the page module runs.

states.label: Sent to the primary host
states.detail: Sign-in or sign-up opened on `<key>.ota.example.com` while a verified custom domain is primary: `location.replace` to the same path there, before any session.

states.label: Temporarily unavailable
states.detail: `403 TENANT_SUSPENDED`: "This travel site is temporarily unavailable", no Retry, `noindex`.

states.label: Storefront does not exist
states.detail: `403 HOST_NOT_ALLOWED`: unknown host, unverified domain, or custom domain of an inactive tenant.

states.label: Service unavailable
states.detail: `503`, connection failure, timeout: Retry puts the page back untouched.

states.label: Something went wrong
states.detail: Any other error, with the request id.

transitions.label: auth page on the sub-domain, custom primary
any call answers 403 TENANT_SUSPENDED: cache dropped, next page
